implementation: engine/rust/question_selection.rs: select; engine/rust/learning.rs: validate_practice_question and unavailable_questions
eligibility: Delivered records are ordinary, unretired, complete keyed single-radio easy questions. Source and generated tasks are deduplicated by shared check_delivery. Seen/current-prefix/reserved practice is excluded before selection. Retired questions fail fresh-practice validation.
weights: With positive easy weight, a pool containing only these easy candidates is uniform after sorting entity IDs. Zero easy weight makes this rated-only pool unavailable; it does not promote another decision case. An unconfigured policy selects the smallest candidate ID.
identity_limit: Future database IDs and learner histories do not exist in this read-only review. Synthetic increasing IDs exercise the exact easy-band hash selection rule; not a prediction of a live learner draw. Every delivered case remains possible for a fresh learner with positive easy weight.
coverage: All five delivered items survive eligibility and difficulty rules; the shortcut item is selected in the fresh and first-item-seen scenarios. Selection does not inspect or remove the defective option pattern.
